verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents building voice agents that join live sessions, with a step-by-step guide, web/mobile and phone connections, turn detection, and hosted model inference. However, no evidence item names the speech-to-text, model, and text-to-speech pipeline stages, so the specific pipeline shape is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the STT→LLM→TTS pipeline and its configuration, named STT/TTS provider integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the voice-agent path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
Build a voice agent in code with this step-by-step guide.
Bring your agent to life through a web or mobile app.
Automatic turn detection and interruption handling
